questions.question_bn: Mass 8 kg rough floor, μs=0.5, g=10। horizontal push 16 N, rest থাকে। actual friction কত N?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Static friction self-adjusts to balance applied force up to limit μsN=5×(8)। actual friction 2×(8), maximum নয়।

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 140 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?

questions.question_bn: Hydratesample containsanhydrous 0.10 mol ও water 1.7000000000000002 mol। formula salt·xH₂O হলে x কত?

questions.question_bn: 2H₂+O₂→2H₂O। H₂=63 mol,O₂=21 mol। remainingH₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। O₂limitingn moluses 2nH₂। initial 3×(21) minusconsumed 2×(21) leavesn mol; product 2×(21) আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: First-order reaction half-life 6min। 75% consumed হতে কত min?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। 75% consumption means 25% remaining=(½)²। two half-lives elapsed; time 2×(6) min, not linear 75% scaling।

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 84mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 21mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Al³⁺+3e⁻→Al; charge 9F,100%efficiency,MAl27। aluminium কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Three electron per mole Al⇒(9)/3 mol Al। mass 27·(9)/3=9ng, oxidation state dependent।

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 24 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 12 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Initial H⁺0.2×(12) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(12) mmol; excess 0.1×(12) mmol,total 3×(12) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।

questions.question_bn: Food sample 2 kg-এ preservative 22mg। mass-based concentration কত ppm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Mass ppm=mg solute/kg sample। (22) mg/2 kg=(22)/2 ppm; total food mass denominator।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C17H34 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
